mechanism.claim: Three consecutive same-signed BTC funding settlements whose absolute cash rate rises monotonically while the completed sixteen-hour BTC return moves against that funding sign identify increasingly expensive losing leverage. The price direction should persist during the next deleveraging handoff.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the completed 16-hour BTC log return
mechanism.why_distinct: MFDH uses an ordered three-settlement realized-funding path and adverse price divergence. It uses no fixed multi-day trend concordance, analog model, RV20 entry gate, implied volatility, order flow, OI, or Gross9 state.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: leveraged crowding that becomes more expensive while losing against price; the full-calendar policy is later audited on the exact causal RV20 q90 slice
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: entries require a rare ordered funding path at actual eight-hour settlements

features.funding_event: actual completed Binance BTCUSDT USD-M funding settlement S
features.funding_path: f0 at S and the immediately preceding f1 and f2 are finite, nonzero, identically signed, and abs(f2)<abs(f1)<abs(f0)
features.return_16h: log(C[S-1m]/O[S-16h]) from 960 exact completed one-minute bars
features.return_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(return_16h) is at least 0.60 among at most 270 valid settlement observations, minimum 180; current observation excluded
features.availability: all funding events and minute bars must be present by S; missing, duplicated, non-finite, nonpositive, late, or incoherent rows make S ineligible

rv20_stress_slice.daily_return: log(C_d/C_{d-1}) assigned to UTC calendar day d
rv20_stress_slice.rv20: sqrt(365*mean(r_d^2)) over exact returns t-20 through t-1
rv20_stress_slice.threshold: numpy linear 0.90 quantile over 756 available RV20 observations with decision timestamps strictly before t; current excluded
rv20_stress_slice.future_use: report-only until all sequential full-calendar stages pass

clock.decision: actual funding settlement S after the settled rate is available
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_accounting: signal uses only completed settlements through S; exact realized funding during [entry,exit) is opened only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, and final
post_stage_volatility_audit.persistent_long_vol_comparator: same accepted candidate entry/exit clock and 0.5 gross, side forced long
post_stage_volatility_audit.full_calendar_decomposition: candidate net return minus comparator net return
post_stage_volatility_audit.rv20_q90_decomposition: same decomposition restricted by causal RV20 state at candidate decision

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no funding path, rank, history, direction, hold, RV20, threshold, subset, comparator, control, or gate repair
